text: Obiskovalka je vesela, ker hitro najde pismo, vendar rezultat še preveri ob posnetku.
rationale: The narrator explicitly attributes joy to the visitor.

text: Navdušena kustosinja pokaže obiskovalcem obnovljeni plakat.
rationale: The adjective explicitly describes the curator.

text: Vodja je dejal: »Obiskovalci se bojijo, da bo zbirka zaprta.«
rationale: The report attributes fear to visitors inside a quotation.

text: Izjemno, še ena čudovita zamuda pri odprtju razstave.
rationale: Positive wording is an ironic negative evaluation; no discrete emotion is safely assigned.

text: Jeza v zapisu ni nujno jeza avtorja poročila.
rationale: The sentence discusses attribution and explicitly rejects the inference about the author.

text: Časnik je zapisal da so se meščani bali spremembe.
rationale: Fear is attributed to townspeople rather than to the newspaper.

text: Urednica ni bila žalostna zaradi kritike temveč zaskrbljena zaradi manjkajočega vira.
rationale: Negation cancels sadness while the second predicate attributes concern.

text: »Kako čudovito,« je zapisala po novi napaki.
rationale: The positive word is ironic; the passage licenses evaluation but not a discrete inner emotion.
